name: pianobar-state

name: pianobar-browsers

name: pianobar-command
description: Send one command as a JSON object, including prompt replies: text and promptId. Inspect state after commands.

name: pianobar-settings-update
description: Update settings with a JSON object containing settings and optional apply. Use direct authenticated REST for credentials to avoid Rook journal retention.

name: pianobar-browser-update
description: Update a page with JSON: id and name, volume (0..1), or enabled (boolean).

name: pianobar-route
description: Replace browser audio destinations: targets is all, none, or a JSON array of browser IDs. All selects currently connected pages; new pages start silent.

name: pianobar-station
description: Select a station by ID.

name: pianobar-saved

name: pianobar-output
description: Set native audio output: host, browser, or both.

name: pianobar-queue-saved
description: Queue a saved song by library ID after the current offline song finishes. Use saved to play immediately.

name: pianobar-dj
description: Inspect DJ model readiness, current context and cached-song station state.

name: pianobar-dj-speak
description: Speak a DJ line through the Kaiju voice endpoint to browsers with DJ introductions enabled. At most 700 characters.

name: pianobar-dj-control
description: Start/stop the cached-song LLM station. JSON: enabled boolean, optional theme and style.

name: pianobar-dj-pick
description: LLM chooses and introduces one cached song. JSON: optional play=true for immediate playback, theme and style. Default queues next.

name: pianobar-dj-introduce
description: Generate a short introduction for the current song. JSON: optional style. Returns text; use dj-speak to announce it.
